title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.
